message: You've rehabilitated Benkler for me. Well, that's an exaggeration: I like WoN. But its strong undercurrent of individualism unnerves me, especially as he seems to imagine unfettered personal choice. To have it contextualized in process pedagogy (of which I am not one of the kill-it-now camp) is to place it in a friendly home where I can feel more comfortable with it. I'll be teaching WoN in my grad class next spring; I'll be interested to see how students react to it.
